thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Pager triggered -> AUTH.JWT.SIGNATURE_FAILURE (prod us-east-1). 15% auth error rate on /token/validate and downstream APIs. Pager: oncall-eng

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired -> maria.dev (primary oncall)

maria.dev: Acked. I'm on it — seeing elevated 401s with 'invalid signature' across multiple services. Starting triage.

kevin.sre: Confirming logs show a lot of 'invalid signature' and 'no matching key found for kid' messages. Looks like kid mismatch. Example from auth-service logs:
```
2026-03-14T15:02:10Z auth-service ERROR token_validation.go:142 "invalid signature: no key with kid=2026-rotated-key found in JWKS"
2026-03-14T15:02:11Z auth-service WARN  proxy        401 /v1/chat  user=abc
```

tom.prod: Is the JWKS endpoint healthy? Could be jwks fetch failing or stale cache.

maria.dev: Hitting JWKS URL now -> https://auth.redwood.internal/.well-known/jwks.json returns 500 from one pod and 200 from others. Some responses have only the new key, some only the old. Looks like a partial rollout of the key rotation.

incident-bot: escalation -> SRE (kevin.sre) and platform (leo_platform)

leo_platform: I'm checking deployments. There was a key rotation this morning via the rotation job. It updated public keys in the keystore but the auth-service config (JWKS_URL env) didn't get the updated entry in the k8s secret for some nodes. Likely a race while the rotation and secret propagation happened.

sara_support: Customer-impact check: Payments and webhooks teams reporting auth failures. Early estimate: ~12% of customer API calls failing auth, majorly in us-east-1. Raising CS page to notify top-tier customers.

maria.dev: Mitigation options: 1) Point auth-service to backup JWKS endpoint (auth-backup) that serves both old+new keys 2) Patch auth-service to accept both kids by merging keys in-memory 3) Roll back rotation if we can't re-sync quickly. Plan: start with (1) as lowest-risk.

kevin.sre: Agree. I'll prepare the secret patch to add backup JWKS URL to config and deploy a canary. Also adding temporary metric to detect 'no matching key' errors.

tom.prod: I'll do the canary rollout in us-east-1 now. Command I'll run:
```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/auth-service JWKS_URL=https://auth-backup.internal/.well-known/jwks.json --record
kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-service -n prod -l region=us-east-1 --cascade
```

leo_platform: Preparing patch for k8s secret in case we need to update the canonical value:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: auth-config
  namespace: prod
stringData:
  JWKS_URL: "https://auth-backup.internal/.well-known/jwks.json,https://auth.redwood.internal/.well-known/jwks.json"
```

maria.dev: Canary started at 15:10 UTC. Monitoring auth error rate -> initial drop observed: 15% -> 1.5% on canary nodes after 3 minutes. Good sign.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: auto-escalation suppressed (incident acknowledged)

kevin.sre: Root cause notes so far: morning key rotation job published new public key (kid=2026-rotated-key) but a subset of auth-service pods read an older cached secret (kid=2025-legacy-key). JWKS responses were inconsistent across pods leading to token validation hitting pk set without matching kid. No malformed tokens — server-side key mismatch.

maria.dev: Rolling the config to all pods now. Tom, please expand rollout to other regions after canary hits steady state.

tom.prod: Expanding rollout to all regions at 15:18 UTC. Monitoring latency and error rates.

maria.dev: Observed global auth error rate down to <1% after full rollout (15:23 UTC). Re-checking logs for lingering 'no key' errors. Minimal tailing errors, likely from cached clients.

leo_platform: Follow-ups: 1) Add preflight check to key rotation pipeline to ensure secrets updated and readable by all pods before publishing 2) Add stronger alert for JWKS inconsistency (5xx from JWKS or >2s 4xx rate during rotation) 3) Update rotation runbook to include immediate config rollout.

sara_support: Notifying impacted customers with temporary mitigation note. Will send follow-up once postmortem is available.

maria.dev: Creating incident channel #incident-auth-1855004321 and opening postmortem draft. Short summary: JWKS rotation partially rolled out -> inconsistent JWKS across replicas -> token kid mismatch -> elevated 401s. Mitigated by switching JWKS URL to backup and forcing config rollout.

kevin.sre: Adding action items and owners in the postmortem. I'll own the pipeline check and alerting changes.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged -> mitigated. Pager closed at 15:30 UTC.

maria.dev: Closing thread here. Will publish postmortem and remediation tickets by EOD. Thanks everyone for fast response. TL;DR: rotation race caused key mismatch; hotfix was config merge to serve both keys via backup JWKS followed by full rollout.
